name: Starry-Eyed Skyrider — "Attacking tokens you control have flying"
notes: Found by tests/sweep.py. 'tokens' is not a type word, so filterReferencesPermanents rejected the subject and the static grant produced no effect. It is now accepted as a bare subject ('[attacking] tokens [you control]'), deliberately NOT for 'those tokens' / 'the tokens', which mean objects an effect just created. The attacking token gains flying; the attacking nontoken creature and the token that stayed home do not.
